build_multilingual_transformer_model: build a multilingual transformer model for multiple language pairs using MultilingualTransformerModel.build_model
add_multilingual_transformer_args: add multilingual transformer arguments like share-encoders and share-decoders to an argparse parser
configure_base_multilingual_architecture: configure the base multilingual transformer architecture with default embedding and sharing settings
configure_iwslt_de_en_architecture: configure the IWSLT German-English multilingual transformer architecture with 512-dim embeddings and 6 layers
load_multilingual_state_dict: load a state dict into a multilingual transformer model filtering to existing language pairs
